'''Aquar''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was a capable [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and was skilled in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair, dodging, and the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|starship shielding]]. Aquar was also culturally knowledgeable and stood two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. He wore a tunic over a [[shirt]] with pants, shoes and a [[Mon Calamari helmet|helmet]]. He carried a blaster, a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]], a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aquar was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Aquar's character type was given as just "Mon Calamari" and his model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
